tagline: Real conversations cut tight: a red quote pill on the opener, big centre captions in two colours (you in white, the other voice in yellow italic), and nothing else on screen.
readiness_note: Two-person Q&A works best with two cameras (or one 4K wide); Solo answer needs just you talking.

captions: F-A opener: host on top, asker below, the red question pill, the asker's words in yellow italic on the seam
F-A body: full-frame host, white word-group captions with one bold word, hard cuts and jump re-crops
F-B solo answer: you on top, the question card below, the pill carrying the question
